{{Quote|Well, we found the little ones. What about the mother?''"<br />"''Haven't seen it.|Anakin Skywalker and Captain Rex, shortly before the assassin probe appears and attacks the latter|<ref name="Voyage of Temptation">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref>}}
An '''assassin probe''' was one of two others smuggled onto the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] during its voyage to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet/Legends|assassinate]] [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. It was the third and final one to be defeated by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].
